rv.q: So it is here, in a show that bursts with energy and makes a truly joyful noise.

It feels fitting that Taylor (who also directs and composed the title song) has, after so many years of celebrating the roots of others, given her own upbringing and influences the flowers they deserve.
The BET cast radiated their signature charisma and style, captivating viewers with their soulful songs.

But, as always at BET, it’s the brilliantly delivered musical numbers, sung by a talented cast, backed by a gifted onstage band and enhanced by some animated and cheerful choreography, that truly elevates this show to a pleasure.
This production is a real winner!
This production is a must-see, as it's not just a play but a deeply engaging emotional journey.
Elvis Presley Was A Black Man Named Joe is a fun, nostalgic, touching, and educational show.

cn.t: Critics praise Jackie Taylor's autobiographical musical as a moving and entertaining tribute that skillfully weaves together her love for Elvis Presley and her late brother Joe, celebrating their intertwined legacies with warmth and nostalgia.
